questions.stem: 70-year-old retired man presents with low grade fever, painless swelling in the neck and fatigue for the past 3 months. Examination reveals generalized lymphadenopathy and mild splenomegaly. CBC shows WBC 85,000/µL with absolute lymphocyte count 65,000/µL. Peripheral smear shows numerous small mature-appearing lymphocytes and smudge cells. Which of the following is the investigation of choice to confirm the diagnosis?
